title: observability: add token-level KV tracing, structured logs, dashboards, and alert tuning
author: Priya Shah
description:
Motivation: Improve root-cause visibility for high token-cost incidents and KV cache regressions by adding token-level KV tracing, structured token->cost logs, updated Grafana dashboards, and tuned alert thresholds. This change ties together metrics, traces, and logs so on-call can quickly map an outlier request to model variant, KV hit/miss behavior, and per-token cost impact.

What this PR does: 1) instrument serving runtime to emit token-level KV events (kv.token.hit/miss) and attach trace/span IDs; 2) add structured logs for token-cost attribution (request_id, model_version, route, token_index, token_cost_us); 3) extend existing token-cost and latency Grafana dashboards with new panels for KV hit ratio by model variant and per-token cost waterfall; 4) tune alerting rules to reduce noise (increase smoothing windows, add secondary signals for sustained cost delta); 5) add a lightweight smoke test for the tracing/log pipeline.

Notes: The description below includes the checklist (done) and the high-level rationale for tuning thresholds (see linked Linear ENG-4321). Rolling deploys will happen first in staging for 24h before promoting to prod. Logs and metrics are backward-compatible; no schema-breaking changes to existing metrics.

Checklist: - [x] Instrumentation in runtime added and feature-flagged - [x] Structured logs schema documented - [x] Grafana dashboard JSON + templating added - [x] Alert rules updated and documented in infra/observability - [x] Unit + integration tests - [x] Smoke test for trace/log pipeline - [x] Staged rollout plan documented (release notes)

Related: Linear ENG-4321, ENG-4389 (KV cache improvements).

review_comments: Ethan Park (reviewer): Looks good overall. Two requests: 1) make sure the structured log schema uses snake_case to match log ingestion mappings, 2) can we add an opt-out feature flag for high-volume customers?

Priya Shah (author): Addressed — switched schema to snake_case and added feature flag runtime.config.observability.token_kv_tracing (default=true) with customer opt-out documented in docs/observability/structured_logs.md.
Marta Lopez (reviewer): Alert tuning LGTM but suggest longer smoothing for noisy routes (e.g., /chat/bulk). Updated token_cost_rules.yaml to use a 5m->15m sustained window for bulk routes.
Daniel Kim (sre): Minor comment: the smoke test depends on a mock exporter; added a retry loop to make the test less flakey. CI passed locally.
Priya Shah (author): Fixed flakey test and pushed test retry logic.
release_notes: Added token-level KV tracing and structured token-cost logs; new Grafana panels for KV hit ratio and per-token cost waterfall; tuned alerts to reduce noise. Safe rollout behind feature flag.
